setting.time_period: Late 19th century during British rule in India, Victorian era
setting.world: Real-world British India and surrounding seas, with anthropomorphized talking animals that follow a Jungle Law
setting.description: Jungle hills, wolf caves and Council Rock at Seeonee, Indian village with plowed fields and grazing grounds by the Waingunga River, ruined Cold Lairs city, English bungalow garden in Segowlee cantonment, elephant Keddah camps in Garo hills, military review camp at Rawal Pindi, and seal beaches at Novastoshnah in the Bering Sea and across the Pacific; interlinked wilderness and colonial human settlements.

characters.name: Mowgli
characters.physical_description: A naked brown human baby boy; typically unclothed in the jungle with white scars on arms and legs.

characters.name: Father Wolf
characters.physical_description: A large adult wolf with sleepy paws and white teeth, lean and muscular with grizzled fur; shown crouching with haunches under him ready to spring.

characters.name: Mother Wolf
characters.physical_description: A large gray she-wolf with a big gray nose and eyes like two green moons in darkness; nursing build lying across her cubs in the cave.

characters.name: Tabaqui
characters.physical_description: A small jackal with a bushy tail, skulking slight build; shabby-coated scavenger with whining expression.

characters.name: Shere Khan
characters.physical_description: A huge tiger with great square head and massive shoulders, striped orange coat; lame in one foot from birth.

characters.name: Akela
characters.physical_description: A great gray lone wolf, large and gaunt with gray fur, lying at full length on the Council Rock; old with scarred veteran build.

characters.name: Baloo
characters.physical_description: A big serious sleepy brown bear with thick faded brown fur and large paws; bulky shambling build, able to rear up on hind quarters.

characters.name: Bagheera
characters.physical_description: An inky-black panther with panther rosettes showing like watered silk in certain light, glossy black coat and soft skin; lithe powerful build with steel-blue talons and a small bald spot under his silky chin.

characters.name: Kaa
characters.physical_description: A huge thirty-foot rock python with mottled brown and yellow new skin, big blunt-nosed head; immensely long thick coiled body.

characters.name: Gray Brother
characters.physical_description: A gray wolf, eldest cub of Mother Wolf, lean wolf build with bristles on back; soft gray nose and lolling tongue.

characters.name: Rann
characters.physical_description: A kite hawk with broad wings showing upturned flanges in sunlight; soaring raptor with keen telescope eyes.

characters.name: Messua
characters.physical_description: An Indian village woman with heavy copper rings on wrists and ankles; wearing sari, with motherly face peering under palm of hand.

characters.name: Buldeo
characters.physical_description: An old Indian village hunter with a Tower musket across his knees; gray-bearded elder in village clothes.

characters.name: Rama
characters.physical_description: A huge slaty-blue herd bull buffalo with long backward-sweeping horns and savage eyes; massive humped bovine build.

characters.name: Kotick
characters.physical_description: A fur-seal pup born all head and shoulders with pale watery blue eyes; flippered marine build with mustache.

characters.name: Sea Catch
characters.physical_description: A huge fifteen-year-old gray fur-seal with almost a mane on shoulders and long wicked dogteeth; over four feet tall on front flippers, nearly seven hundred pounds, scarred all over.

characters.name: Matkah
characters.physical_description: A soft sleek gentle-eyed female fur-seal; smaller smooth-coated seal with hind flippers used as a fan.

characters.name: Kerick Booterin
characters.physical_description: A black-haired Aleut man with flat red face, oily smoke-stained skin; wearing a cap and carrying seal clubs, with heavy boots.

characters.name: Patalamon
characters.physical_description: A young black-haired Aleut boy-man with flat red face; son of Kerick, dressed in island hunter's clothes.

characters.name: Sea Vitch
characters.physical_description: A big ugly bloated pimpled fat-necked long-tusked walrus of the North Pacific; massive blubbery bulk with whiskered muzzle.

characters.name: Sea Cow
characters.physical_description: A huge twenty to thirty foot long sea cow with shovel-like tail, no hind flippers, foolish-looking head and split upper lip; glassy green eyes and waving front flippers.

characters.name: Limmershin
characters.physical_description: A very odd tiny winter wren bird; small brown feathered body with thin beak.

characters.name: Rikki-tikki-tavi
characters.physical_description: A small mongoose rather like a little cat in fur and tail but like a weasel in head, with pink eyes and end of restless nose; bottle-brush tail when fluffed, able to sit back on tail and hind legs.

characters.name: Teddy
characters.physical_description: A small English boy in an Indian bungalow; short fair child in children's clothes.

characters.name: Alice
characters.physical_description: An Englishwoman mother in a bungalow, pale white face; wearing colonial domestic dress.

characters.name: Darzee
characters.physical_description: A tiny tailorbird with bright plumage; small perching bird that stitches leaves together for a nest.

characters.name: Nag
characters.physical_description: A big five-foot-long black cobra with spread hood bearing a spectacle-mark like hook-and-eye; cold snake eyes and forked tongue.

characters.name: Nagaina
characters.physical_description: A large female cobra, mate of Nag, with hooded head and wicked coiled body; dusty-scaled serpent with savage hiss.

characters.name: Karait
characters.physical_description: A tiny dusty brown snakeling lying on dusty earth; very small gray-brown venomous snake.

characters.name: Chuchundra
characters.physical_description: A small brokenhearted muskrat that creeps round by walls; bewhiskered mousy furred rodent with tears on whiskers.

characters.name: Kala Nag
characters.physical_description: A huge ten-foot-at-shoulder tusker elephant with tusks cut short at five feet and bound with copper bands; dark gray wrinkled hide.

characters.name: Big Toomai
characters.physical_description: An adult Indian mahout elephant-driver, son of Black Toomai; brown-skinned man in mahout clothes carrying a heavy iron ankus.

characters.name: Little Toomai
characters.physical_description: A ten-year-old Indian boy four feet tall wearing only one rag, sun-bleached brown hair flying loose; small brown barefoot child.

characters.name: Petersen Sahib
characters.physical_description: A large white man head of Keddah operations with mustache; lying along an elephant's back in hunting dress.

characters.name: Machua Appa
characters.physical_description: An old hairy scarred brown elephant-catcher and head tracker-driver; weathered jungle hunter in native clothes.

characters.name: Pudmini
characters.physical_description: A clever female elephant, Petersen Sahib's pet; large gray elephant with chain-galls, carrying leg-irons.

characters.name: Billy
aliases: breech-piece mule of number two gun
number two gun of the First Screw Battery
characters.physical_description: A fourteen-hand screw-gun battery mule with harness straps rings and chains and saddle-pad; sturdy long-eared mule.

characters.name: Two Tails
characters.physical_description: A large gun-team elephant harnessed to artillery; massive gray elephant with iron ring on foot and trunk used as voice.

characters.name: Vixen
characters.physical_description: A small fox-terrier dog; short white-and-tan terrier with yapping bark, muddy from camp.

chapters.title: Mowgli’s Brothers
chapters.summary: A man's cub wanders into the Seeonee wolves' cave and Raksha the Demon claims him as Mowgli the Frog, defying Shere Khan the lame tiger. Bought into the Pack for a bull by Bagheera and taught by Baloo, Mowgli grows strong for ten years until the young wolves turn against him and old Akela. Armed with the Red Flower of fire, Mowgli drives off Shere Khan, frees Akela, and leaves the jungle weeping to return to men, vowing to bring back Shere Khan's hide.
chapters.cover_description: A naked brown-skinned boy with long black hair holding a blazing fire-brand aloft on Council Rock at night, cowering wolves and a huge lame striped tiger shrinking before the flames beside a black panther and an old gray wolf.

chapters.title: Kaa’s Hunting
chapters.summary: While learning Jungle Law from Baloo and Bagheera, Mowgli is kidnapped by the lawless Bandar-log and carried to the ruined Cold Lairs. Baloo and Bagheera ally with Kaa the Rock Python, who storms the Monkey City, rescues Mowgli from a cobra den, and fascinates the monkeys with his Hunger Dance, after which Mowgli is punished and brought home.
chapters.cover_description: Thirty-foot rock python Kaa coiled on the moonlit marble terrace of the ruined Cold Lairs, facing rings of terrified monkeys while Bagheera fights in the water tank and Mowgli is trapped in the broken-domed summerhouse.

chapters.title: “Tiger! Tiger!”
chapters.summary: Cast out by the Wolf Pack, Mowgli is taken in by Messua's village as her lost son Nathoo and learns men's ways while serving as buffalo herder. With Akela and Gray Brother he traps the man-eater Shere Khan between two buffalo herds in the Waingunga ravine and takes his skin. Driven from the village as a sorcerer, he spreads the hide on the Council Rock to keep his promise, then renounces both Packs to hunt alone.
chapters.cover_description: Mowgli dancing on Shere Khan's huge striped tiger skin spread on the Council Rock by moonlight, surrounded by wolves and Bagheera the black panther, triumphantly raising his arms.

chapters.title: The White Seal
chapters.summary: White seal pup Kotick is born at crowded Novastoshnah and, after witnessing men club the holluschickie at the Salt House, vows to find a men-free island for seals. Rebuffed by Sea Lion, Sea Vitch, and his own people, he searches the world's oceans for five years until the Sea Cow lead him through an undersea tunnel to perfect sheltered beaches. He wins leadership by defeating all challengers in a great fight and leads his people in exodus to the safe northern home.
chapters.cover_description: A pure-white seal pup with pale blue eyes rearing up on a foggy, crowded black-rock nursery beach among thousands of dark fighting seals, with phosphorescent fire-wake surf glowing behind him at night.

chapters.title: “Rikki-Tikki-Tavi”
chapters.summary: Flood-washed mongoose Rikki-tikki-tavi is adopted by an English family at Segowlee and learns cobras Nag and Nagaina terrorize the garden. He kills the tiny Karait to save Teddy, then overhears the cobras plotting to murder the family and grapples Nag in the bathroom until the father shoots him. Rikki crushes Nagaina's melon-bed eggs, baits her away from Teddy with the last egg, and follows her into her hole to kill her, becoming the garden's honored guardian.
chapters.cover_description: A small bottle-brush-tailed mongoose rearing on hind legs red-eyed before a huge five-foot black cobra with spread spectacle-marked hood, in a lush Indian bungalow garden with thorn-bush, veranda and melon patch behind them.

chapters.title: Toomai of the Elephants
chapters.summary: Ten-year-old Little Toomai, son of mahout Big Toomai, serves with the great tusker Kala Nag in the Garo hills keddah drives and is told by Petersen Sahib he may enter the keddah when he has seen the elephants dance. That night Kala Nag breaks his picket and carries the boy deep into the forest to a hidden clearing where scores of wild elephants stamp for hours in the secret dance. Verified by Petersen Sahib and Machua Appa from trampled earth and seventy tracks, the boy is honored by the whole c
chapters.cover_description: Little Toomai clinging to Kala Nag's neck at the edge of a moonlit jungle clearing, watching scores of wild elephants stamping together in the great night dance, dust and dew rising under iron-gray moonlight.

chapters.title: Her Majesty’s Servants
chapters.summary: On a rainy night at Rawal Pindi, the narrator hides among artillery and overhears a baggage-camel, Billy the screw-gun mule, a troop-horse, young mule, gun-bullocks and elephant Two Tails debate their different fears and ways of fighting. They agree all obey orders without question, proven when the bullocks flee a hidden white man and at the next day's vast review before the Viceroy and Amir, which obedience alone makes possible.
chapters.cover_description: On a dark rain-soaked night at Rawal Pindi, a loose baggage-camel collapses a white officer's tent while a fox-terrier flees, with artillery guns, mules and an elephant looming in mud and drizzle behind.
